title: Spyglass: Officially Launched and Ready for You!
summary: We're excited to announce that Spyglass has officially launched out of beta, providing all users with a powerful, stable, and enhanced experience for deeper insights.

title: Seamless File Management in the Editor
summary: Experience a significant upgrade in file handling, empowering you to effortlessly manage, upload, link, download, and customize the display of all your embedded files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to effortlessly track recent product updates, preview what's coming next, and discover our exciting future vision.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've upgraded our checkboxes to be larger, more modern, and effortlessly draggable, making your task management clearer and more efficient.

title: Smarter Teamwork
summary: Experience a smoother, more intuitive way to work together, with enhanced visibility into your team's real-time progress.

title: Seamless Collaboration and Shared Item Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to share and discover valuable items with your collaborators, empowering more connected and productive teamwork.

title: Expanding Language Options
summary: Get ready for Noeko in more languages as we extend our platform to welcome users from every corner of the globe.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to open source Noeko's codebase, empowering our community with maximum control, fostering direct involvement in its growth, and ensuring complete transparency.

title: Dynamic Constellation View
summary: Discover new insights and streamline your workflows with an enhanced Constellation view that lets you filter by tags, time, and shared items for unparalleled clarity.

title: Precision Search & Curated Knowledge Collections
summary: Refine your knowledge search with powerful filtering and sorting options, then effortlessly save your customized results into a dedicated collection for quick retrieval.

title: Dynamic Note Previews
summary: We're introducing new visual display options and enhanced interactivity for your linked content, allowing you to organize your thoughts more intuitively and efficiently.

title: Noeko: Launching Self-Host and Premium Access
summary: Get ready to deploy Noeko on your infrastructure or explore powerful new premium plans, offering enhanced control and features for individuals and teams alike.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Fresh and Refined Themes
summary: Get ready for a visual refresh as we perfect existing themes and introduce a vibrant collection of new ones, offering more options for every user.

title: Dynamic Greetings for a Personalized Experience
summary: We're ensuring your greetings always precisely match the time of day, providing a more accurate and welcoming start to your application experience.

title: Effortless Tag & Item Management
summary: Gain more control over your content by performing quick actions, such as unapplying tags and deleting items, directly from your list views for a seamless organizational experience.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Unlock the power of diverse information by easily bringing in content from YouTube videos, websites, text files, and pasted text, all within our platform.
